episodes.tldr: See it coming: arm swing changed ~7 years before Parkinson's diagnoses, AlphaGenome 2 predicts what DNA changes do cell by cell, and brain scans flagged risks before diagnosis.
titles: Arm swing changed nearly seven years before a Parkinson's diagnosis, a Sydney team found
Google DeepMind's AlphaGenome 2 predicts what a DNA change does in each type of cell
Experts appointed by OpenAI say its AI-made proof for part of a Millennium Prize Problem checks out

episodes.tldr: Prove it: DeepMind says AI agents machine-checked Signal's encryption code, Beam says a one-letter gene edit hit its sickle cell goal, and higher wellbeing was linked to ~2 more years.
titles: Google DeepMind says its AI agents proved key security properties of Signal's encryption code
Beam's one-letter gene edit met its goal in a pivotal sickle cell trial
Google's Gemini 4 Carbon is out, with a swarm mode that turns one prompt into a team of agents

episodes.tldr: Fast forward: Anthropic says AI agents machine-checked Fermat in 30 hours, one gene-editing infusion cut a risky blood fat 63% early on, and a psilocybin therapy is filed with the FDA.
titles: Anthropic says 1,000 AI agents machine-checked Fermat's Last Theorem in 30 hours
One gene-editing infusion cut a risky blood fat by 63% in an early trial
Anthropic says its new model built a working operating system from an empty folder in 8 days

episodes.tldr: Show your work: an AI-found quantum proof checked by software, gene-edited cells that helped 9 of 9 myositis patients early on, and online sessions that steadied anxiety in pregnancy.
titles: A startup's AI found a proof for an 18-year-old quantum computing puzzle, checked by software
An audit found Anthropic's AI improving about twice as fast, but most of the evidence was redacted
OpenAI says GPT-6 Cyber found 81 serious Firefox bugs, and Mozilla is shipping fixes

episodes.tldr: Sleep on it: silencing some sleep cells made mice forget, a gene therapy plus a pill cut seizures in 3 patients, and exam stress showed up in Australian campus sewage.
titles: Mice with some sleep cells silenced slept normally but forgot what they'd learned
Falling asleep earlier, not sleeping longer, went with more weight loss
Anthropic says its Claude agents 'dream' to fix their own memory notes

episodes.tldr: Factory reset? A drug got old rats' livers clearing an Alzheimer's-linked protein again, a start-up says its AI proved a quantum puzzle open since 2008, and a humanoid cleaned a reporter's home.
titles: A drug got old rats' livers clearing an Alzheimer's-linked protein again
Start-up PSI says its AI system proved a quantum computing conjecture open since 2008
Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Small is set to be the top open model outside China

episodes.tldr: Level up: an outside review finds AI is now speeding up AI at Anthropic, a drug plus vibration seemed to help flush Alzheimer's-linked proteins in 29 people, and a robot moth grew its own sensor.
titles: An outside review finds Anthropic's AI is improving about twice as fast, mostly thanks to AI
OpenAI says its GPT-6 Cyber found 81 unknown, serious flaws in Firefox
Sydney physicists found a one-bit nudge can send an AI's training somewhere else

episodes.tldr: Early signs: 80,000 blood samples will be searched for the first clues of brain disease, an AI screens questionnaires for Parkinson's, and an hour of nature a week brings half the possible boost.
titles: UK Biobank will search 80,000 stored blood samples for the first protein clues of brain disease
An AI reads long health questionnaires to flag possible Parkinson's sooner
Thirty people with ALS will test a wearable brain interface for communicating at home

episodes.tldr: Self-improvement: Anthropic says AI helping build AI may soon speed up sharply, an early trial fixed a faulty DNA letter in the liver, and six humanoids worked a 24-hour shift.
titles: Anthropic's IPO filing says AI helping build AI may soon sharply speed up its progress
In an early trial, base editing fixed the faulty DNA letter behind alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency in the liver
Pinal, an AI from Westlake University, designs proteins from plain-language descriptions

episodes.tldr: One step at a time: a third blind volunteer got a vision implant, a Huntington's gene therapy got an FDA decision date, and robots climbed Mount Tai's 3,000 steps.
titles: A third blind volunteer got a wireless brain implant aimed at restoring some sight
The FDA set a 1 May 2027 decision date for uniQure's Huntington's gene therapy
OpenAI's LifeVal benchmark grades AI on everyday tasks; GPT-6 Astra averages 80.6%

episodes.tldr: Never too late: two treatments helped old mice live longer, retiring didn't make older Australians lonelier, and a psychedelic spray eased tough depression in a mid-stage trial.
titles: Blocking one enzyme helped old mice live 17% longer
Retiring didn't make older Australians any lonelier
